name: Phantom Circuit
detailed_description:
⚠ Attention

The game is in the early stages of development. Many of its aspects — mechanics, style, and atmosphere — will be refined and improved in the future.

  • The full version of the game is designed for 3-5 hours of gameplay.

About the game

You play as a young detective who accidentally encounters the mysterious Phantom Circuit agency. At first, it appears to be an ordinary detective organization that hires you for investigations. But soon you find out that Phantom Circuit is actually hunting paranormal phenomena and carefully hiding it from the public.

Controls

  • Movement: W, A, S, D

  • Running: Hold Shift

  • Crouch: Hold Ctrl

  • Interact: E

  • Drag and drop items: Hold LMB

Abilities

Your character can use both hands: each slot can be equipped with the right items for specific purposes.

  • Important: If your right hand is occupied, you will not be able to drag and drop items.

short_description: "Phantom Circuit" is a mysterious organization that hunts ghosts. As a young exorcist, you will explore dark houses. Your task is to find traces of the paranormal, collect evidence, and send reports to the central office. But be careful: there is a deception at work.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Turkish, Italian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil
